data.rationale: The 5 critical ACID bugs are now fixed. Entity rollback (redoing writes from WAL on recovery) is a separate feature that needs careful design - it requires storing full entity state in WAL WRITE entries, not just entity_id and version. Current WAL-first model means recovery already knows which transactions committed; entity rollback would add the ability to reconstruct entities from WAL alone.
data.title: Entity rollback deferred to future sprint
